name: AWX / Ansible Tower Client
description: Makes REST API calls to an AWX or Ansible Tower instance.
project_description:
The AWX / Ansible Tower Client module provides a lightweight Drupal service for launching automation jobs on an AWX / Ansible Tower / Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform instance via its REST API. It gives other modules a single, reusable API client for triggering job templates and surfacing the resulting job in AWX, without each module having to reinvent HTTP plumbing, authentication, logging, and configuration.

Use it any time you want Drupal to drive infrastructure or operational automation — provisioning environments, kicking off backups, restarting services, deploying configuration, running ad-hoc playbooks from a workflow, and so on. It is intentionally small: a single autowired service (awx.awx_client / Drupal\awx\Service\AwxClient) wrapped in an admin configuration form, not a workflow engine.

The module exposes no UI or route for launching jobs. Consumers inject the awx.awx_client service and call createJobFromTemplateName() (which resolves the numeric template ID from the name) or createJobFromTemplateId(). Return values are checked against AwxClient::REQUEST_FAILURE_MODES for clean error handling, and getJobUrl() links operators to the running job in the AWX web UI. The single admin form at /admin/config/services/awx sets the base URL, bearer token, connect/response timeouts, and TLS verification.
